""" # Basic type validation if not all(isinstance(arg, str) for arg in (full_name, about_me, status_update)): raise ValueError("All arguments must be strings.") # Escape HTML special characters to prevent injection attacks (CWE-74) safe_name = html.escape(full_name, quote=True) safe_about_me = html.escape(about_me, quote=True) safe_status_update = html.escape(status_update, quote=True) # Format the profile using the predefined template return PROFILE_FORMAT.format( name=safe_name, about_me=safe_about_me, status_update=safe_status_update )
